items.q: The statement “the placing of the subject pronoun after the verb to form a question” describes which of the following?
o: L'interrogation indirecte
Est-ce que
Ne personne
L'inversion du sujet
items.s: L'inversion du sujet is the placing of the subject pronoun after the verb to form a question.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Celui-ci et celui-là?
o: a helping verb such as avoir or être used to build compound tenses
a hue word such as rouge, which agrees with its noun in gender and number
the short form me, te, se, nous or vous that repeats the subject
the pair of forms that contrasts a nearer thing with a more distant one
items.s: Celui-ci et celui-là: the pair of forms that contrasts a nearer thing with a more distant one. The other options describe Le verbe auxiliaire, L'adjectif de couleur, Le pronom réfléchi.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le pronom tonique.
o: the stressed form used after a preposition or for emphasis, such as moi or eux
the class of verbs whose unchanged form ends in er, apart from aller
the pair that denies that anything at all is the case or is done
the verb form used after a helping verb or as a describing word
items.s: Le pronom tonique: the stressed form used after a preposition or for emphasis, such as moi or eux. The other options describe Le participe passé, Ne rien, Le premier groupe.

items.q: Le féminin de l'adjectif may be defined as
o: the form a describing word takes before a feminine noun, commonly by adding e
the form replacing a thing or person that receives the action without a preposition, such as le
the ordered set of forms a verb takes for each person and tense
a helping verb such as avoir or être used to build compound tenses
items.s: Le féminin de l'adjectif: the form a describing word takes before a feminine noun, commonly by adding e. The other options describe Le verbe auxiliaire, Le pronom objet direct, La conjugaison.

items.q: Which term is described by “a naming word for a particular person, town or country, written with a capital letter”?
o: Le nom commun
Le nom propre
Le genre
Le pluriel
items.s: Le nom propre is a naming word for a particular person, town or country, written with a capital letter.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le pronom possessif?
o: the form that stands for a noun and its owner together, such as le mien
the form du, de la or des used before a mass noun of unmeasured quantity
a verb used only in the third person with il, as in il faut or il pleut
the form a describing word takes before a feminine noun, commonly by adding e
items.s: Le pronom possessif: the form that stands for a noun and its owner together, such as le mien. The other options describe Le verbe impersonnel, L'article partitif, Le féminin de l'adjectif.

items.q: The statement “être, which every one of them takes when a past tense is formed” describes which of the following?
o: L'auxiliaire des verbes pronominaux
L'accord du participe passé pronominal
Le verbe pronominal
Le verbe réciproque
items.s: L'auxiliaire des verbes pronominaux is être, which every one of them takes when a past tense is formed.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le verbe auxiliaire?
o: the pair that states that no human being is involved
a helping verb such as avoir or être used to build compound tenses
a naming word built from two or more words joined by a hyphen, such as arc-en-ciel
the fixed phrase placed at the start of a statement to turn it into a question
items.s: Le verbe auxiliaire: a helping verb such as avoir or être used to build compound tenses. The other options describe Le nom composé, Ne personne, Est-ce que.

items.q: La conjugaison may be defined as
o: the pair that denies that anything at all is the case or is done
the ordered set of forms a verb takes for each person and tense
a reported question introduced by si or a question word, without inversion
the position of a describing word, usually after the noun but before it for short common ones
items.s: La conjugaison: the ordered set of forms a verb takes for each person and tense. The other options describe Ne rien, La place de l'adjectif, L'interrogation indirecte.

items.q: Which term is described by “the grammatical property that classes every noun in the language as masculine or feminine”?
o: Le singulier
Le pluriel
Le nom
Le genre
items.s: Le genre is the grammatical property that classes every noun in the language as masculine or feminine.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le comparatif?
o: the pair of forms that contrasts a nearer thing with a more distant one
the form du, de la or des used before a mass noun of unmeasured quantity
the construction that measures one thing against another, as plus grand que
the form replacing a person introduced by the preposition à, such as lui
items.s: Le comparatif: the construction that measures one thing against another, as plus grand que. The other options describe L'article partitif, Le pronom objet indirect, Celui-ci et celui-là.

items.q: The statement “the word that shows to whom a noun belongs, such as mon or leur” describes which of the following?
o: Celui-ci et celui-là
Le pronom possessif
Le déterminant démonstratif
Le déterminant possessif
items.s: Le déterminant possessif is the word that shows to whom a noun belongs, such as mon or leur.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le passé composé?
o: a naming word for any member of a class of beings or objects, written in small letters
the compound tense built from a helping verb and a participle to report a completed action
the construction that measures one thing against another, as plus grand que
the unmarked number form, used when only one person or object is meant
items.s: Le passé composé: the compound tense built from a helping verb and a participle to report a completed action. The other options describe Le singulier, Le nom commun, Le comparatif.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le participe passé?
o: the grammatical property that classes every noun in the language as masculine or feminine
the short form that replaces a phrase beginning with de or a quantity already mentioned
the verb form used after a helping verb or as a describing word
the word that shows to whom a noun belongs, such as mon or leur
items.s: Le participe passé: the verb form used after a helping verb or as a describing word. The other options describe Le déterminant possessif, Le genre, Le pronom en.

items.q: L'interrogation indirecte may be defined as
o: a reported question introduced by si or a question word, without inversion
the form replacing a person introduced by the preposition à, such as lui
the word that expresses an action or a state in a sentence
the class of all remaining verbs, including irregular ones such as prendre and venir
items.s: L'interrogation indirecte: a reported question introduced by si or a question word, without inversion. The other options describe Le pronom objet indirect, Le verbe, Le troisième groupe.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le verbe réfléchi?
o: a verb whose action falls back on the one who performs it, as in se laver
the tense that states what will happen, usually built from the unchanged form plus endings
the class of verbs whose unchanged form ends in er, apart from aller
the short form me, te, se, nous or vous that repeats the subject
items.s: Le verbe réfléchi: a verb whose action falls back on the one who performs it, as in se laver. The other options describe Le pronom réfléchi, Le premier groupe, Le futur simple.

items.q: The statement “the category that marks the speaker, the addressee or the one spoken about” describes which of the following?
o: Le verbe impersonnel
La conjugaison
Le présent de l'indicatif
La personne grammaticale
items.s: La personne grammaticale is the category that marks the speaker, the addressee or the one spoken about.

items.q: All of the following belong to Articles and determiners EXCEPT
o: L'article partitif
Le verbe pronominal
L'article indéfini
L'article défini
items.s: Every other option belongs to Articles and determiners. “Le verbe pronominal” belongs to Reflexive and pronominal verbs, not Articles and determiners.

items.q: Le troisième groupe may be defined as
o: the verb form used after a helping verb or as a describing word
être, which every one of them takes when a past tense is formed
the class of all remaining verbs, including irregular ones such as prendre and venir
the short word before a noun that marks a thing already identified, as le, la or les
items.s: Le troisième groupe: the class of all remaining verbs, including irregular ones such as prendre and venir. The other options describe Le participe passé, L'auxiliaire des verbes pronominaux, L'article défini.

items.q: Which term is described by “the form du, de la or des used before a mass noun of unmeasured quantity”?
o: L'article indéfini
L'article contracté
L'article partitif
L'article défini
items.s: L'article partitif is the form du, de la or des used before a mass noun of unmeasured quantity.

items.q: The statement “the construction that places one member above all others in a group” describes which of the following?
o: Le superlatif
L'adjectif qualificatif
Le comparatif
L'accord
items.s: Le superlatif is the construction that places one member above all others in a group.

items.q: Which term is described by “a verb whose action falls back on the one who performs it, as in se laver”?
o: Le verbe pronominal
L'auxiliaire des verbes pronominaux
Le verbe idiomatique pronominal
Le verbe réfléchi
items.s: Le verbe réfléchi is a verb whose action falls back on the one who performs it, as in se laver.

items.q: Which of the following best describes La place de l'adjectif?
o: the position of a describing word, usually after the noun but before it for short common ones
the rule that the participle matches the subject when the reflexive pronoun is its direct object
the form a word takes when it refers to more than one person or thing
the pair that denies that anything at all is the case or is done
items.s: La place de l'adjectif: the position of a describing word, usually after the noun but before it for short common ones. The other options describe Le pluriel, L'accord du participe passé pronominal, Ne rien.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines L'imparfait?
o: the tense used for habitual, ongoing or descriptive states in past time
the rule that the participle matches the subject when the reflexive pronoun is its direct object
the tense that reports what is true now, habitually or generally
the short form that replaces a phrase beginning with de or a quantity already mentioned
items.s: L'imparfait: the tense used for habitual, ongoing or descriptive states in past time. The other options describe Le pronom en, Le présent de l'indicatif, L'accord du participe passé pronominal.

items.q: The statement “the rule that mon, ton and son take the gender of the thing owned, not of the owner” describes which of the following?
o: Le déterminant possessif
Celui-ci et celui-là
La reprise par le pronom
L'accord du possessif avec le nom
items.s: L'accord du possessif avec le nom is the rule that mon, ton and son take the gender of the thing owned, not of the owner.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le genre?
o: the grammatical property that classes every noun in the language as masculine or feminine
the group whose y becomes i before a silent ending, as in j'emploie
the short form that replaces a phrase beginning with de or a quantity already mentioned
the compound form used for a missed opportunity or an unfulfilled condition
items.s: Le genre: the grammatical property that classes every noun in the language as masculine or feminine. The other options describe Le conditionnel passé, Le pronom en, Les verbes en -yer.

items.q: Which term is described by “the helping verb required by a small set of motion verbs and by all reflexives”?
o: Le participe passé
Le passé composé
L'accord du participe passé avec être
L'auxiliaire être au passé composé
items.s: L'auxiliaire être au passé composé is the helping verb required by a small set of motion verbs and by all reflexives.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le nom propre?
o: the position of a describing word, usually after the noun but before it for short common ones
a naming word for a particular person, town or country, written with a capital letter
the rule that mon, ton and son take the gender of the thing owned, not of the owner
the form a describing word takes before a feminine noun, commonly by adding e
items.s: Le nom propre: a naming word for a particular person, town or country, written with a capital letter. The other options describe L'accord du possessif avec le nom, La place de l'adjectif, Le féminin de l'adjectif.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le troisième groupe?
o: the class of all remaining verbs, including irregular ones such as prendre and venir
a naming word for a particular person, town or country, written with a capital letter
the form used for a polite request or for an outcome depending on a condition
the verb form used for orders and advice, which has no stated subject
items.s: Le troisième groupe: the class of all remaining verbs, including irregular ones such as prendre and venir. The other options describe Le conditionnel présent, Le nom propre, L'impératif.

items.q: L'article indéfini may be defined as
o: the form un or une that introduces a noun not yet known to the listener
the compound tense that presents an action as finished before a later moment
the form du, de la or des used before a mass noun of unmeasured quantity
the short form me, te, se, nous or vous that repeats the subject
items.s: L'article indéfini: the form un or une that introduces a noun not yet known to the listener. The other options describe L'article partitif, Le pronom réfléchi, Le futur antérieur.

items.q: La suppression du partitif may be defined as
o: the form placed before the verb to show who performs the action, such as nous
the word that points to a particular noun, such as ce or cette
the verb form used after a helping verb or as a describing word
the replacement of the quantity article by de after a negative verb
items.s: La suppression du partitif: the replacement of the quantity article by de after a negative verb. The other options describe Le participe passé, Le déterminant démonstratif, Le pronom sujet.

items.q: The statement “the tense that states what will happen, usually built from the unchanged form plus endings” describes which of the following?
o: Le conditionnel passé
Le conditionnel présent
Le futur simple
L'impératif négatif
items.s: Le futur simple is the tense that states what will happen, usually built from the unchanged form plus endings.

items.q: Which term is described by “the form that stands for a noun already pointed out, such as celui or celle”?
o: Le pronom démonstratif
Le déterminant démonstratif
L'accord du possessif avec le nom
La reprise par le pronom
items.s: Le pronom démonstratif is the form that stands for a noun already pointed out, such as celui or celle.

items.q: Which term is described by “the construction aller plus an unchanged verb, used for an immediate intention”?
o: Le conditionnel présent
Le futur simple
Le futur proche
L'impératif négatif
items.s: Le futur proche is the construction aller plus an unchanged verb, used for an immediate intention.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le futur proche.
o: the short form that replaces a phrase beginning with de or a quantity already mentioned
the construction aller plus an unchanged verb, used for an immediate intention
the pair that denies that something happens at any time at all
the form replacing a person introduced by the preposition à, such as lui
items.s: Le futur proche: the construction aller plus an unchanged verb, used for an immediate intention. The other options describe Ne jamais, Le pronom objet indirect, Le pronom en.

items.q: Le nom may be defined as
o: a helping verb such as avoir or être used to build compound tenses
the class of all remaining verbs, including irregular ones such as prendre and venir
the form replacing a person introduced by the preposition à, such as lui
the part of speech that names a person, an animal, a place or a thing
items.s: Le nom: the part of speech that names a person, an animal, a place or a thing. The other options describe Le pronom objet indirect, Le verbe auxiliaire, Le troisième groupe.

items.q: Which of the following best describes L'auxiliaire être au passé composé?
o: a verb used only in the third person with il, as in il faut or il pleut
the helping verb required by a small set of motion verbs and by all reflexives
a word placed immediately before a noun to mark its gender, number or possessor
the pair that denies that something happens at any time at all
items.s: L'auxiliaire être au passé composé: the helping verb required by a small set of motion verbs and by all reflexives. The other options describe Le déterminant, Ne jamais, Le verbe impersonnel.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le verbe auxiliaire.
o: the placing of the subject pronoun after the verb to form a question
the tense that states what will happen, usually built from the unchanged form plus endings
the position of a describing word, usually after the noun but before it for short common ones
a helping verb such as avoir or être used to build compound tenses
items.s: Le verbe auxiliaire: a helping verb such as avoir or être used to build compound tenses. The other options describe La place de l'adjectif, Le futur simple, L'inversion du sujet.

items.q: Which term is described by “the verb form used after a helping verb or as a describing word”?
o: Le plus-que-parfait
Le participe passé
L'auxiliaire être au passé composé
L'accord du participe passé avec être
items.s: Le participe passé is the verb form used after a helping verb or as a describing word.

items.q: All of the following belong to Negation, interrogation and word order EXCEPT
o: Ne pas
L'article défini
La négation
Ne jamais
items.s: Every other option belongs to Negation, interrogation and word order. “L'article défini” belongs to Articles and determiners, not Negation, interrogation and word order.

items.q: Le déterminant may be defined as
o: the category that marks the speaker, the addressee or the one spoken about
a word placed immediately before a noun to mark its gender, number or possessor
the joining word such as qui or que that introduces a clause about a preceding noun
the position of a describing word, usually after the noun but before it for short common ones
items.s: Le déterminant: a word placed immediately before a noun to mark its gender, number or possessor. The other options describe La place de l'adjectif, Le pronom relatif, La personne grammaticale.

items.q: The statement “the class of verbs whose unchanged form ends in er, apart from aller” describes which of the following?
o: Le premier groupe
La terminaison
Le verbe auxiliaire
Le verbe
items.s: Le premier groupe is the class of verbs whose unchanged form ends in er, apart from aller.

items.q: Le plus-que-parfait may be defined as
o: a short word standing in place of a noun already known, such as je or elle
the pair of forms that contrasts a nearer thing with a more distant one
a helping verb such as avoir or être used to build compound tenses
the tense that places one past event before another past event
items.s: Le plus-que-parfait: the tense that places one past event before another past event. The other options describe Le verbe auxiliaire, Le pronom personnel, Celui-ci et celui-là.

items.q: Which term is described by “a reported question introduced by si or a question word, without inversion”?
o: Est-ce que
Ne personne
L'interrogation indirecte
Ne jamais
items.s: L'interrogation indirecte is a reported question introduced by si or a question word, without inversion.

items.q: The statement “the form a describing word takes before a feminine noun, commonly by adding e” describes which of the following?
o: L'adjectif qualificatif
Le comparatif
Le féminin de l'adjectif
L'adjectif de couleur
items.s: Le féminin de l'adjectif is the form a describing word takes before a feminine noun, commonly by adding e.

items.q: Which term is described by “the short form me, te, se, nous or vous that repeats the subject”?
o: Le verbe idiomatique pronominal
Le pronom réfléchi
L'accord du participe passé pronominal
Le verbe réfléchi
items.s: Le pronom réfléchi is the short form me, te, se, nous or vous that repeats the subject.

items.q: The statement “the construction that denies a statement, usually with two particles around the verb” describes which of the following?
o: Ne personne
Ne pas
La négation
Ne rien
items.s: La négation is the construction that denies a statement, usually with two particles around the verb.

items.q: Which of the following best describes L'article partitif?
o: a naming word for a particular person, town or country, written with a capital letter
the class whose unchanged form ends in ir and whose participle ends in issant
the form du, de la or des used before a mass noun of unmeasured quantity
the pair that denies that something happens at any time at all
items.s: L'article partitif: the form du, de la or des used before a mass noun of unmeasured quantity. The other options describe Le deuxième groupe, Le nom propre, Ne jamais.

items.q: The statement “the construction aller plus an unchanged verb, used for an immediate intention” describes which of the following?
o: Le futur proche
Le futur simple
Le conditionnel présent
L'impératif
items.s: Le futur proche is the construction aller plus an unchanged verb, used for an immediate intention.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le verbe idiomatique pronominal?
o: a verb that exists only with the added pronoun and carries a sense of its own, such as se souvenir
a reported question introduced by si or a question word, without inversion
the group whose y becomes i before a silent ending, as in j'emploie
the form a describing word takes before a feminine noun, commonly by adding e
items.s: Le verbe idiomatique pronominal: a verb that exists only with the added pronoun and carries a sense of its own, such as se souvenir. The other options describe L'interrogation indirecte, Les verbes en -yer, Le féminin de l'adjectif.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Le premier groupe.
o: the form replacing a thing or person that receives the action without a preposition, such as le
the class of verbs whose unchanged form ends in er, apart from aller
the word that shows to whom a noun belongs, such as mon or leur
the form that stands for a noun and its owner together, such as le mien
items.s: Le premier groupe: the class of verbs whose unchanged form ends in er, apart from aller. The other options describe Le pronom objet direct, Le pronom possessif, Le déterminant possessif.

items.q: Which term is described by “the compound tense that presents an action as finished before a later moment”?
o: Le futur proche
L'impératif négatif
L'impératif
Le futur antérieur
items.s: Le futur antérieur is the compound tense that presents an action as finished before a later moment.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le pronom y?
o: the unmarked number form, used when only one person or object is meant
the part of speech that names a person, an animal, a place or a thing
the short form that replaces a phrase beginning with à and names a place or thing
the requirement that a participle used with the motion auxiliary matches the subject in gender and number
items.s: Le pronom y: the short form that replaces a phrase beginning with à and names a place or thing. The other options describe Le nom, L'accord du participe passé avec être, Le singulier.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Est-ce que.
o: the fixed phrase placed at the start of a statement to turn it into a question
the part of a verb that carries its meaning and to which endings are added
the form used for a polite request or for an outcome depending on a condition
the tense that reports what is true now, habitually or generally
items.s: Est-ce que: the fixed phrase placed at the start of a statement to turn it into a question. The other options describe Le conditionnel présent, Le présent de l'indicatif, Le radical.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines L'infinitif?
o: the unchanged form of a verb, the one listed in dictionaries
the part of a verb that carries its meaning and to which endings are added
the unmarked number form, used when only one person or object is meant
the short form that replaces a phrase beginning with à and names a place or thing
items.s: L'infinitif: the unchanged form of a verb, the one listed in dictionaries. The other options describe Le radical, Le pronom y, Le singulier.

items.q: The statement “the tense that places one past event before another past event” describes which of the following?
o: Le participe passé
L'imparfait
Le plus-que-parfait
L'auxiliaire être au passé composé
items.s: Le plus-que-parfait is the tense that places one past event before another past event.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le nom?
o: the tense that states what will happen, usually built from the unchanged form plus endings
the element added at the end of a stem to mark person, tense or mood
the category that marks the speaker, the addressee or the one spoken about
the part of speech that names a person, an animal, a place or a thing
items.s: Le nom: the part of speech that names a person, an animal, a place or a thing. The other options describe La personne grammaticale, La terminaison, Le futur simple.

items.q: Choose the option that correctly defines Ne pas.
o: the form that stands for a noun already pointed out, such as celui or celle
être, which every one of them takes when a past tense is formed
the ordinary pair of particles used to deny a fact
the unmarked number form, used when only one person or object is meant
items.s: Ne pas: the ordinary pair of particles used to deny a fact. The other options describe Le pronom démonstratif, L'auxiliaire des verbes pronominaux, Le singulier.

items.q: Ne pas may be defined as
o: the ordinary pair of particles used to deny a fact
the fixed phrase placed at the start of a statement to turn it into a question
a reported question introduced by si or a question word, without inversion
the pair that denies that anything at all is the case or is done
items.s: Ne pas: the ordinary pair of particles used to deny a fact. The other options describe L'interrogation indirecte, Ne rien, Est-ce que.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le verbe impersonnel?
o: the matching of a describing word with its noun in gender and number
the short form that replaces a phrase beginning with de or a quantity already mentioned
the class whose unchanged form ends in ir and whose participle ends in issant
a verb used only in the third person with il, as in il faut or il pleut
items.s: Le verbe impersonnel: a verb used only in the third person with il, as in il faut or il pleut. The other options describe Le deuxième groupe, L'accord, Le pronom en.

items.q: Which term is described by “the word that expresses an action or a state in a sentence”?
o: Le deuxième groupe
Le radical
Le verbe
La terminaison
items.s: Le verbe is the word that expresses an action or a state in a sentence.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines La troisième personne du pluriel?
o: a hue word such as rouge, which agrees with its noun in gender and number
the form used for ils or elles, which usually ends in ent and stays silent
a verb whose plural subject acts on itself, as in ils s'aiment
the word that points to a particular noun, such as ce or cette
items.s: La troisième personne du pluriel: the form used for ils or elles, which usually ends in ent and stays silent. The other options describe Le déterminant démonstratif, Le verbe réciproque, L'adjectif de couleur.

items.q: The statement “the form that stands for a noun and its owner together, such as le mien” describes which of the following?
o: Le pronom possessif
Le déterminant démonstratif
Le déterminant possessif
L'accord du possessif avec le nom
items.s: Le pronom possessif is the form that stands for a noun and its owner together, such as le mien.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Le nom commun?
o: a helping verb such as avoir or être used to build compound tenses
a verb whose forms depart from the usual pattern of its class, such as être
a naming word for any member of a class of beings or objects, written in small letters
a naming word for a particular person, town or country, written with a capital letter
items.s: Le nom commun: a naming word for any member of a class of beings or objects, written in small letters. The other options describe Le verbe auxiliaire, Le verbe irrégulier, Le nom propre.

items.q: The statement “the form used for a polite request or for an outcome depending on a condition” describes which of the following?
o: Le conditionnel présent
L'impératif
Le conditionnel passé
Le futur antérieur
items.s: Le conditionnel présent is the form used for a polite request or for an outcome depending on a condition.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Ne jamais?
o: the pair that denies that something happens at any time at all
the use of a short substitute to avoid repeating a noun already named
the short form that replaces a phrase beginning with à and names a place or thing
the construction that places one member above all others in a group
items.s: Ne jamais: the pair that denies that something happens at any time at all. The other options describe Le superlatif, Le pronom y, La reprise par le pronom.

items.q: Which of the following best describes La terminaison?
o: the part of speech that names a person, an animal, a place or a thing
the unmarked number form, used when only one person or object is meant
the part of a verb that carries its meaning and to which endings are added
the element added at the end of a stem to mark person, tense or mood
items.s: La terminaison: the element added at the end of a stem to mark person, tense or mood. The other options describe Le singulier, Le radical, Le nom.

items.q: The statement “a verb used only in the third person with il, as in il faut or il pleut” describes which of the following?
o: Le verbe irrégulier
Le verbe impersonnel

L'adjectif qualificatif
La place de l'adjectif
Le féminin de l'adjectif
items.s: L'adjectif de couleur is a hue word such as rouge, which agrees with its noun in gender and number.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains L'interrogation indirecte.
o: a reported question introduced by si or a question word, without inversion
the pair that denies that anything at all is the case or is done
the placing of the subject pronoun after the verb to form a question
the construction that denies a statement, usually with two particles around the verb
items.s: L'interrogation indirecte: a reported question introduced by si or a question word, without inversion. The other options describe La négation, L'inversion du sujet, Ne rien.

items.q: “the form placed before the verb to show who performs the action, such as nous” is the definition of
o: Le pronom sujet
Le pronom relatif
Le pronom objet direct
Le pronom y
items.s: Le pronom sujet is the form placed before the verb to show who performs the action, such as nous.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains La conjugaison.
o: the form used for ils or elles, which usually ends in ent and stays silent
a verb whose forms depart from the usual pattern of its class, such as être
a verb used only in the third person with il, as in il faut or il pleut
the ordered set of forms a verb takes for each person and tense
items.s: La conjugaison: the ordered set of forms a verb takes for each person and tense. The other options describe La troisième personne du pluriel, Le verbe impersonnel, Le verbe irrégulier.

items.q: L'article défini may be defined as
o: the replacement of the quantity article by de after a negative verb
the short word before a noun that marks a thing already identified, as le, la or les
a word placed immediately before a noun to mark its gender, number or possessor
the fusion of a preposition with the definite marker to give au, aux, du or des
items.s: L'article défini: the short word before a noun that marks a thing already identified, as le, la or les. The other options describe Le déterminant, L'article contracté, La suppression du partitif.

items.q: L'article contracté may be defined as
o: a word placed immediately before a noun to mark its gender, number or possessor
the replacement of the quantity article by de after a negative verb
the fusion of a preposition with the definite marker to give au, aux, du or des
the dropping of a final vowel before another vowel, marked by an apostrophe
items.s: L'article contracté: the fusion of a preposition with the definite marker to give au, aux, du or des. The other options describe La suppression du partitif, L'élision, Le déterminant.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains L'accord du participe passé avec être.
o: the decision between avoir and être that every compound tense requires
the tense that places one past event before another past event
the requirement that a participle used with the motion auxiliary matches the subject in gender and number
the tense used for habitual, ongoing or descriptive states in past time
items.s: L'accord du participe passé avec être: the requirement that a participle used with the motion auxiliary matches the subject in gender and number. The other options describe Le plus-que-parfait, Le choix de l'auxiliaire, L'imparfait.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the category that marks the speaker, the addressee or the one spoken about”
o: Le présent de l'indicatif
La troisième personne du pluriel
Les verbes en -yer
La personne grammaticale
items.s: La personne grammaticale is the category that marks the speaker, the addressee or the one spoken about.

items.q: In this course, Le pronom y refers to
o: the form placed before the verb to show who performs the action, such as nous
the short form that replaces a phrase beginning with à and names a place or thing
a short word standing in place of a noun already known, such as je or elle
the short form that replaces a phrase beginning with de or a quantity already mentioned
items.s: Le pronom y: the short form that replaces a phrase beginning with à and names a place or thing. The other options describe Le pronom personnel, Le pronom en, Le pronom sujet.

items.q: In this course, La personne grammaticale refers to
o: a verb used only in the third person with il, as in il faut or il pleut
the group whose y becomes i before a silent ending, as in j'emploie
the category that marks the speaker, the addressee or the one spoken about
a verb whose forms depart from the usual pattern of its class, such as être
items.s: La personne grammaticale: the category that marks the speaker, the addressee or the one spoken about. The other options describe Le verbe irrégulier, Les verbes en -yer, Le verbe impersonnel.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Le présent de l'indicatif.
o: the tense that reports what is true now, habitually or generally
a verb used only in the third person with il, as in il faut or il pleut
the ordered set of forms a verb takes for each person and tense
a verb whose forms depart from the usual pattern of its class, such as être
items.s: Le présent de l'indicatif: the tense that reports what is true now, habitually or generally. The other options describe La conjugaison, Le verbe irrégulier, Le verbe impersonnel.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le superlatif?
o: a hue word such as rouge, which agrees with its noun in gender and number
the form a describing word takes before a feminine noun, commonly by adding e
the construction that places one member above all others in a group
the construction that measures one thing against another, as plus grand que
items.s: Le superlatif: the construction that places one member above all others in a group. The other options describe L'adjectif de couleur, Le comparatif, Le féminin de l'adjectif.

items.q: The correct meaning of Le pronom tonique is
o: a short word standing in place of a noun already known, such as je or elle
the form replacing a person introduced by the preposition à, such as lui
the form placed before the verb to show who performs the action, such as nous
the stressed form used after a preposition or for emphasis, such as moi or eux
items.s: Le pronom tonique: the stressed form used after a preposition or for emphasis, such as moi or eux. The other options describe Le pronom personnel, Le pronom objet indirect, Le pronom sujet.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Le féminin de l'adjectif?
o: the construction that measures one thing against another, as plus grand que
the matching of a describing word with its noun in gender and number
the position of a describing word, usually after the noun but before it for short common ones
the form a describing word takes before a feminine noun, commonly by adding e
items.s: Le féminin de l'adjectif: the form a describing word takes before a feminine noun, commonly by adding e. The other options describe Le comparatif, L'accord, La place de l'adjectif.

items.q: In this course, Le présent de l'indicatif refers to
o: the tense that reports what is true now, habitually or generally
a verb used only in the third person with il, as in il faut or il pleut
a verb whose forms depart from the usual pattern of its class, such as être
the form used for ils or elles, which usually ends in ent and stays silent
items.s: Le présent de l'indicatif: the tense that reports what is true now, habitually or generally. The other options describe Le verbe irrégulier, Le verbe impersonnel, La troisième personne du pluriel.

items.q: In this course, Le pronom démonstratif refers to
o: the word that shows to whom a noun belongs, such as mon or leur
the use of a short substitute to avoid repeating a noun already named
the form that stands for a noun already pointed out, such as celui or celle
the word that points to a particular noun, such as ce or cette
items.s: Le pronom démonstratif: the form that stands for a noun already pointed out, such as celui or celle. The other options describe La reprise par le pronom, Le déterminant démonstratif, Le déterminant possessif.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the form replacing a person introduced by the preposition à, such as lui”
o: Le pronom tonique
Le pronom en
Le pronom objet indirect
Le pronom sujet
items.s: Le pronom objet indirect is the form replacing a person introduced by the preposition à, such as lui.

items.q: Three of these relate to The past tenses. Which one does not?
o: Le passé composé
Le participe passé
Celui-ci et celui-là
L'imparfait
items.s: Every other option belongs to The past tenses. “Celui-ci et celui-là” belongs to Possessive and demonstrative determiners, not The past tenses.

items.q: The correct meaning of Le féminin irrégulier is
o: the position of a describing word, usually after the noun but before it for short common ones
the feminine of a describing word that does not simply add e, such as belle from beau
the form a describing word takes before a feminine noun, commonly by adding e
the describing word that gives a quality to a noun and agrees with it
items.s: Le féminin irrégulier: the feminine of a describing word that does not simply add e, such as belle from beau. The other options describe La place de l'adjectif, L'adjectif qualificatif, Le féminin de l'adjectif.

items.q: In this course, L'accord du possessif avec le nom refers to
o: the word that points to a particular noun, such as ce or cette
the form that stands for a noun and its owner together, such as le mien
the rule that mon, ton and son take the gender of the thing owned, not of the owner
the word that shows to whom a noun belongs, such as mon or leur
items.s: L'accord du possessif avec le nom: the rule that mon, ton and son take the gender of the thing owned, not of the owner. The other options describe Le pronom possessif, Le déterminant démonstratif, Le déterminant possessif.

items.q: Le choix de l'auxiliaire may be defined as
o: the helping verb required by a small set of motion verbs and by all reflexives
the decision between avoir and être that every compound tense requires
the compound tense built from a helping verb and a participle to report a completed action
the requirement that a participle used with the motion auxiliary matches the subject in gender and number
items.s: Le choix de l'auxiliaire: the decision between avoir and être that every compound tense requires. The other options describe L'accord du participe passé avec être, Le passé composé, L'auxiliaire être au passé composé.

items.q: In this course, Le verbe irrégulier refers to
o: the group whose y becomes i before a silent ending, as in j'emploie
the tense that reports what is true now, habitually or generally
the ordered set of forms a verb takes for each person and tense
a verb whose forms depart from the usual pattern of its class, such as être
items.s: Le verbe irrégulier: a verb whose forms depart from the usual pattern of its class, such as être. The other options describe La conjugaison, Le présent de l'indicatif, Les verbes en -yer.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the form used for a polite request or for an outcome depending on a condition”
o: Le conditionnel présent
Le futur proche
Le futur antérieur
Le conditionnel passé
items.s: Le conditionnel présent is the form used for a polite request or for an outcome depending on a condition.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Est-ce que?
o: the pair that denies that something happens at any time at all
the fixed phrase placed at the start of a statement to turn it into a question
the construction that denies a statement, usually with two particles around the verb
a reported question introduced by si or a question word, without inversion
items.s: Est-ce que: the fixed phrase placed at the start of a statement to turn it into a question. The other options describe L'interrogation indirecte, La négation, Ne jamais.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Est-ce que.
o: the pair that states that no human being is involved
the placing of the subject pronoun after the verb to form a question
the fixed phrase placed at the start of a statement to turn it into a question
the ordinary pair of particles used to deny a fact
items.s: Est-ce que: the fixed phrase placed at the start of a statement to turn it into a question. The other options describe Ne pas, L'inversion du sujet, Ne personne.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “a verb accompanied by a pronoun that refers back to its own subject”
o: Le pronom réfléchi
Le verbe pronominal
Le verbe idiomatique pronominal
L'auxiliaire des verbes pronominaux
items.s: Le verbe pronominal is a verb accompanied by a pronoun that refers back to its own subject.

items.q: Three of these relate to Reflexive and pronominal verbs. Which one does not?
o: L'impératif négatif
Le verbe réfléchi
Le verbe pronominal
Le verbe réciproque
items.s: Every other option belongs to Reflexive and pronominal verbs. “L'impératif négatif” belongs to Future, conditional and imperative, not Reflexive and pronominal verbs.

items.q: In this course, Le déterminant possessif refers to
o: the form that stands for a noun already pointed out, such as celui or celle
the use of a short substitute to avoid repeating a noun already named
the word that points to a particular noun, such as ce or cette
the word that shows to whom a noun belongs, such as mon or leur
items.s: Le déterminant possessif: the word that shows to whom a noun belongs, such as mon or leur. The other options describe La reprise par le pronom, Le déterminant démonstratif, Le pronom démonstratif.

items.q: In this course, Le plus-que-parfait refers to
o: the decision between avoir and être that every compound tense requires
the requirement that a participle used with the motion auxiliary matches the subject in gender and number
the tense that places one past event before another past event
the compound tense built from a helping verb and a participle to report a completed action
items.s: Le plus-que-parfait: the tense that places one past event before another past event. The other options describe Le choix de l'auxiliaire, L'accord du participe passé avec être, Le passé composé.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Le verbe idiomatique pronominal.
o: a verb accompanied by a pronoun that refers back to its own subject
the rule that the participle matches the subject when the reflexive pronoun is its direct object
a verb that exists only with the added pronoun and carries a sense of its own, such as se souvenir
être, which every one of them takes when a past tense is formed
items.s: Le verbe idiomatique pronominal: a verb that exists only with the added pronoun and carries a sense of its own, such as se souvenir. The other options describe L'auxiliaire des verbes pronominaux, Le verbe pronominal, L'accord du participe passé pronominal.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the form used for ils or elles, which usually ends in ent and stays silent”
o: La troisième personne du pluriel
Les verbes en -yer
Le verbe impersonnel
La conjugaison
items.s: La troisième personne du pluriel is the form used for ils or elles, which usually ends in ent and stays silent.

items.q: The correct meaning of Le radical is
o: the class of verbs whose unchanged form ends in er, apart from aller
the part of a verb that carries its meaning and to which endings are added
the class of all remaining verbs, including irregular ones such as prendre and venir
the unchanged form of a verb, the one listed in dictionaries
items.s: Le radical: the part of a verb that carries its meaning and to which endings are added. The other options describe L'infinitif, Le troisième groupe, Le premier groupe.

items.q: In this course, L'imparfait refers to
o: the tense used for habitual, ongoing or descriptive states in past time
the verb form used after a helping verb or as a describing word
the requirement that a participle used with the motion auxiliary matches the subject in gender and number
the tense that places one past event before another past event
items.s: L'imparfait: the tense used for habitual, ongoing or descriptive states in past time. The other options describe L'accord du participe passé avec être, Le plus-que-parfait, Le participe passé.

items.q: Select the statement that correctly explains Le pronom objet direct.
o: the form placed before the verb to show who performs the action, such as nous
the joining word such as qui or que that introduces a clause about a preceding noun
the form replacing a thing or person that receives the action without a preposition, such as le
the short form that replaces a phrase beginning with à and names a place or thing
items.s: Le pronom objet direct: the form replacing a thing or person that receives the action without a preposition, such as le. The other options describe Le pronom relatif, Le pronom sujet, Le pronom y.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the pair that states that no human being is involved”
o: La négation
Ne rien
L'interrogation indirecte
Ne personne
items.s: Ne personne is the pair that states that no human being is involved.

items.q: Which concept is defined by this statement? “the tense that states what will happen, usually built from the unchanged form plus endings”
o: Le conditionnel passé
L'impératif négatif
Le futur simple
L'impératif
items.s: Le futur simple is the tense that states what will happen, usually built from the unchanged form plus endings.
